name: io.github.bck-stack/sitecheck-crypto-finance
title: SiteCheck Crypto & Finance
description: 175 pay-per-call agent tools: crypto, DeFi, on-chain (Bitcoin, Kaspa, Bittensor), finance. x402

tools.name: crypto_smart_contract_verify
tools.description: EVM contract verification status from Sourcify (open, no key): match type (exact/partial), compiler, contract name, ABI function and event counts, proxy implementations. Only verified contracts; source files are not returned. Unverified contracts give a 404. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

chainId.description: EVM chain id as a number (default 1 = Ethereum mainnet)

tools.name: crypto_honeypot_detector
tools.description: EVM token honeypot check from honeypot.is: simulated buy/sell success, honeypot verdict, buy/sell/transfer tax, risk flags, open-source status and the main DEX pair liquidity. EVM only (no Solana). Simulation results can change with pool state; not financial advice. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_dex_pool_liquidity
tools.description: Live DEX pool snapshot from DexScreener for one pool address on one chain (Uniswap, Raydium, Curve and other DEXes DexScreener indexes): USD liquidity, token reserves, price, 24h volume and transactions, FDV. Slippage is not computed. Data is DexScreener's aggregate, not raw on-chain reads. Takes about 14 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: DexScreener chain slug, e.g. ethereum, base, solana, bsc

tools.name: crypto_defillama_tvl_oracle
tools.description: Current total value locked (TVL, USD) of one DeFi protocol from DefiLlama, by protocol slug (e.g. aave, uniswap-v3). Returns the single current TVL number only; chain breakdown and history are not included. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_defillama_yields when you need DeFi pool APY, TVL, 7/30-day APY change; crypto_defillama_stablecoins when you need stablecoin market cap, 1/7/30-day circulating change, peg. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

protocol.description: DefiLlama protocol slug, lowercase letters, digits and dashes

tools.name: crypto_defillama_stablecoins
tools.description: Stablecoin market cap (circulating USD), 1/7/30-day circulating change (mint/burn proxy), peg price and depeg % from DefiLlama. Pass symbols (e.g. USDT,USDC) or leave empty for the 10 largest. Net change is a change in circulating supply, not separate mint and burn events. Usually answers in a few seconds, up to 15 s on slower calls; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_defillama_yields when you need DeFi pool APY, TVL, 7/30-day APY change; crypto_defillama_tvl_oracle when you need current total value locked of one DeFi protocol. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

symbols.description: Comma-separated stablecoin tickers, up to 10 (default: 10 largest)

tools.name: crypto_defillama_yields
tools.description: DeFi pool APY (total, base, reward), TVL, 7/30-day APY change and impermanent-loss estimate (il7d, ilRisk) from DefiLlama. Filter by project, chain and symbol; returns up to 20 pools by TVL. APY is DefiLlama's estimate, not a guaranteed return. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_defillama_stablecoins when you need stablecoin market cap, 1/7/30-day circulating change, peg; crypto_defillama_tvl_oracle when you need current total value locked of one DeFi protocol. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

project.description: DefiLlama project slug, e.g. aave-v3, curve-dex, uniswap-v3

chain.description: Chain name as DefiLlama writes it, e.g. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum

symbol.description: Token symbol or pair text, e.g. USDC or WETH-USDC

tools.name: crypto_bitcoin_large_txs_latest_block
tools.description: Bitcoin large transactions in the latest block from mempool.space: total output in BTC, fee, txid and block height, filtered by minBtc. Bitcoin only (no ETH or SOL). Covers the first 25 transactions of the tip block; output total includes change, so it is transaction size, not one wallet's transfer. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_bitcoin_whale_txs when you need Large Bitcoin transactions: every transaction of the latest; crypto_bitcoin_block when you need Detailed Bitcoin block summary by height or hash. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

minBtc.description: Minimum total output in BTC, 0.01 to 10000 (default 1)

limit.description: How many transactions to return, 1 to 25 (default 10)

tools.name: crypto_token_holder_concentration
tools.description: Ethereum ERC-20 holder concentration from Blockscout: top 100 holders' share of total supply, top 10 share, and a Gini coefficient over those 100 balances. Gini is over the sampled top holders only, not all holders. For the very largest tokens (e.g. USDT) Blockscout can be too slow for the second page of holders; the answer then covers the top 50 (holdersSampled 50, top100SharePct null) and says so in note. Ethereum mainnet only. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_token_vesting_schedule when you need token emission and unlock schedule per allocation label. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

address.description: ERC-20 token contract on Ethereum mainnet, 0x + 40 hex characters

tools.name: crypto_aave_lending_markets
tools.description: Aave v3 Ethereum main-market reserves: supply and borrow APY, utilization, max LTV, liquidation threshold, supply/borrow caps status, frozen/paused flags, total supplied and available liquidity. Filter by symbol, or get the first 20 reserves. Ethereum main market only. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

symbol.description: Reserve token symbol, e.g. USDC, WETH (optional; default: first 20 reserves)

tools.name: crypto_compound_market_stats
tools.description: Compound v3 (Comet) market stats on Ethereum read on-chain: utilization, supply and borrow APY, total supply and borrow of the base asset, and every collateral asset with its borrow and liquidation collateral factors, liquidation factor and supply cap. Markets: usdc (cUSDCv3) or weth (cWETHv3). Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_nft_collection_activity
tools.description: ERC-721 collection activity on Ethereum from Blockscout: name, holder count, supply and the newest 50 transfers, with round-trip transfers (a token sent A to B and straight back to A) flagged as possible wash signals. No sale prices, floor price or royalties: this source does not provide them. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

address.description: ERC-721 contract address on Ethereum, 0x + 40 hex characters

tools.name: crypto_cross_chain_bridge_flows
tools.description: Cross-chain transfer volume from Wormholescan (Wormhole network): USD and token counts grouped by source to destination chain over the newest N transfers (1 to 100). A recent window, not total bridge TVL or long-term trends. Transfers with no USD price are counted but not summed. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many of the newest transfers to read, 1 to 100 (default 50)

tools.name: crypto_solana_token_extensions
tools.description: Solana SPL mint audit from the chain: program (Token or Token-2022), authorities, supply and decimals, plus Token-2022 extensions with risk flags for permanent delegate, transfer hook, transfer fee, default frozen state and mint close. Reads the mint account only; it does not check holders or liquidity. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_solana_validator_cluster when you need Solana validator snapshot from the public RPC: active. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_mev_block_analytics
tools.description: Ethereum MEV-Boost delivered blocks from the Flashbots relay: proposer payment in ETH (block value), transaction count, gas used vs limit, and builder pubkeys with block counts. Covers the newest blocks only (1 to 50). Sandwich volume is not in this source and is not reported. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many of the newest delivered blocks, 1 to 50 (default 10)

tools.name: crypto_ethereum_gas_telemetry
tools.description: Ethereum EIP-1559 gas per recent block: base fee (gwei), gas used ratio, and priority fee (tip) percentiles at 10/50/90 from eth_feeHistory, plus the next block's base fee. Gas used by contract is not included (this RPC does not give it). Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_ethereum_staking_rewards when you need Ethereum proof-of-stake yield snapshot: Lido stETH APR. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_token_vesting_schedule
tools.description: Token emission and unlock schedule per allocation label (team, investors, rewards, etc.) from DefiLlama emissions data, by protocol slug: last unlock day and amount, next scheduled unlock (if any in the data), and total unlocked to date. Amounts are in tokens. Coverage depends on DefiLlama having the protocol's emissions file. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_token_holder_concentration when you need Ethereum ERC-20 holder concentration from Blockscout: top. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

protocol.description: DefiLlama emissions slug, lowercase, e.g. aave

tools.name: crypto_coingecko_market_depth
tools.description: CoinGecko per-exchange market depth for one coin: USD cost to move price up 2% and down 2% (liquidity), 24h volume in USD, last price and bid-ask spread, for the 15 highest-volume trading pairs. Each row is one exchange pair, not a merged order book. Data is CoinGecko's, updated on its own schedule. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_coingecko_spot_prices when you need CoinGecko spot prices for up to 10 coins in one currency. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

coin.description: CoinGecko coin id (bitcoin, ethereum, solana) or a ticker symbol (BTC, ETH, SOL, USDC); a ticker is matched to the largest coin with that symbol

tools.name: crypto_coinmarketcap_listings
tools.description: Recently added tokens on CoinMarketCap (public new-listings page): name, symbol, date added, price, 24h change, 24h volume and market cap, from the page's embedded data. Exchange volume rank is not on this page and is not reported. Reads the public page, not the paid API. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_coinmarketcap_top_rankings when you need CoinMarketCap ranked crypto listing: name, symbol, USD. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_fear_greed_index
tools.description: Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0-100) from alternative.me: today's value and label, change vs yesterday and vs 7 days ago, 7-day average, and a sentiment momentum label (rising, falling, flat). Daily; the source updates once a day. Attribution to alternative.me is requested by the source. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

days.description: How many daily values to read, 8 to 30 (default 30; needs at least 8 for the 7-day figures)

tools.name: crypto_bitcoin_mempool_stats
tools.description: Bitcoin mempool congestion from mempool.space: unconfirmed transaction count and size, recommended fee rates in sat/vB, difficulty-adjustment progress and estimated retarget date, and blocks until the next halving (every 210,000 blocks). Current snapshot only; no history. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_bitcoin_mempool_pressure when you need Bitcoin mempool pressure state and projected next blocks; crypto_bitcoin_network_snapshot when you need Bitcoin network snapshot from mempool.space: recommended. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_bitcoin_hashrate_difficulty
tools.description: Bitcoin network hashrate (EH/s) with the last 3 daily averages, current difficulty, difficulty-epoch progress and expected change, and miner revenue over the last 144 blocks (about one day): total reward incl. fees in BTC, fee share and average reward per block. Network-wide figures from mempool.space, not per-miner. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_bitcoin_mining_pools when you need Bitcoin mining pool hashrate and block shares over 24h, 3d; crypto_bitcoin_ordinals_flow when you need Bitcoin Ordinals inscription activity for the last N blocks. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_ethereum_staking_rewards
tools.description: Ethereum proof-of-stake yield snapshot: Lido stETH APR (protocol-wide, after Lido fees) and the beacon chain's finalized and justified epochs with the finality flag. Validator queue and churn are not in these sources and are not reported. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_ethereum_gas_telemetry when you need Ethereum EIP-1559 gas per recent block: base fee, gas used. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_solana_validator_cluster
tools.description: Solana validator snapshot from the public RPC: active and delinquent validator counts, total active stake in SOL, stake-weighted commission, cluster skip rate over the latest epoch block production, and the top validators by stake with their commission and skip rate. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_solana_token_extensions when you need Solana SPL mint audit from the chain: program, authorities. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

top.description: How many top validators by stake to list, 1 to 25 (default 5)

tools.name: crypto_lido_steth_peg
tools.description: Lido stETH vs ETH peg from public USD prices (DefiLlama coins API): stETH and ETH price, discount or premium in %, plus Lido's total stETH staked and market cap. The two prices can be quoted a few minutes apart. Curve pool balances and the Lido withdrawal queue are not included. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_makerdao_vault_status
tools.description: Sky (MakerDAO) savings rates and peg: sUSDS and sDAI savings APY and TVL on Ethereum (DefiLlama yields), DAI and USDS USD price and depeg %, and circulating supply. Vault collateralization is not in these sources and is not reported. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_fundraising_rounds
tools.description: Recent crypto and Web3 venture funding rounds (project, date, round type, amount and valuation in USD, lead and other investors, category, chains) from DefiLlama's public Raises page. Filter by date window, investor, category, chain, round or minimum amount. Amounts are as DefiLlama lists them and can be missing for undisclosed rounds; new rounds appear within days. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

days.description: Look back this many days, 1 to 365 (default 30). Ignored when since is given.

investor.description: Optional investor name filter (lead or other), e.g. a16z, Coinbase Ventures

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. DeFi, Infrastructure, Gaming

chain.description: Optional chain filter, e.g. Solana, Ethereum

round.description: Optional round filter, e.g. Seed, Series A, Strategic

tools.name: crypto_binance_orderbook_depth
tools.description: Binance spot order book snapshot for one pair: best bid and ask, spread, USD depth within 1% and 2% of mid price (from the returned levels only), and 24h volume, change and high/low. Up to 100 levels per side. Snapshot only; Binance market data, not a merged multi-exchange book. Takes about 12 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_binance_prices when you need Binance spot last price for one trading pair. Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

symbol.description: Binance spot pair, e.g. BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT

tools.name: crypto_coinbase_orderbook
tools.description: Coinbase Exchange (US spot) order book for one product: best bid and ask, spread, USD depth within 1% and 2% of mid (aggregated level-2 levels only), 24h base volume, 24h RFQ (institutional request-for-quote) volume, last price and 24h high/low. Coinbase Exchange data only, not Coinbase Advanced or other venues. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_coinbase_candles when you need Coinbase Exchange OHLCV candles for one product at 1m, 5m; crypto_coinbase_exchange_products when you need Coinbase Exchange trading products with status and minimum. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

product.description: Coinbase product id such as BTC-USD or ETH-USD

tools.name: crypto_deribit_options_skew
tools.description: Deribit BTC or ETH options for one expiry (default: nearest unexpired): at-the-money implied volatility (mark IV), and an IV skew at ±10% moneyness (put at 0.9x spot minus call at 1.1x spot, in IV points). This is a moneyness skew, not a 25-delta skew: Deribit's summary has no delta, so per-strike delta calls are not made. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

expiry.description: Expiry as Deribit writes it, e.g. 30OCT26 (optional; default nearest)

tools.name: crypto_okx_liquidations
tools.description: OKX perpetual-swap liquidations for one underlying (e.g. BTC-USD): the most recent 100 filled forced liquidations, split into long and short liquidated USD value, with the largest events. Covers OKX only, and the window is the latest 100 events, not a fixed 24h total. Other exchanges' liquidation streams are not reported. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_debank_defi_net_worth
tools.description: Multi-chain wallet net worth with DeFi positions and debt (40+ EVM chains and Solana, data from the Zerion API): total value in USD split by wallet, deposited, borrowed, locked and staked, top chains, and every protocol position (protocol, chain, type such as deposit, loan, staked, reward or locked, token, amount and USD value) grouped by protocol, with total debt. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_evm_wallet_token_balances
tools.description: Token balances of an EVM wallet across chains from Blockscout explorers: native coin and ERC-20 holdings with amount, USD price and USD value (largest first), plus per-chain and overall USD totals. Ethereum, Optimism and Gnosis by default; Base, Arbitrum and Polygon when the operator's free Blockscout key is set. Prices are Blockscout's; airdropped tokens can be spam. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

chains.description: Comma list from ethereum, optimism, gnosis, base, arbitrum, polygon (default: every chain available)

tools.name: crypto_zerion_wallet_portfolio
tools.description: On-chain wallet portfolio and performance from Zerion across 40+ EVM chains and Solana: total value in USD, split by position type (wallet, deposited, borrowed, locked, staked) and by chain, 1-day change, lifetime PnL (realized, unrealized, total gain and %, invested, fees) and, with a period, the value history chart (up to 60 points). Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

period.description: Optional value chart: hour, day, week, month, 3months, 6months, year, 5years or max

tools.name: crypto_etherscan_label_cloud
tools.description: Etherscan public address-label cloud: entity labels (e.g. Binance, 0x Protocol) with counts of tagged accounts, transactions and tokens, from the label page's embedded data. Filter by name or take the top labels by total. Does not list individual deposit wallets and does not separate CEX deposit tags from other labels. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

name.description: Optional case-insensitive part of a label name, e.g. binance

tools.name: crypto_solscan_account_tokens
tools.description: Solana account inventory: SOL balance, every SPL token account (Token and Token-2022 programs) with mint, amount, decimals and frozen state, token name, symbol, USD price and value for the largest holdings (Jupiter token data), and the latest transaction signatures with time and status. Read from Solana RPC. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: Token accounts to return, 1 to 100 (default 20; non-zero balances, largest USD value first)

tools.name: crypto_base_contract_events
tools.description: Recent event logs of a contract on Base (chain 8453) from public RPC: block, time order, transaction hash, log index, event name (signature database), topics and data, with ERC-20/721 Transfer and Approval decoded to from/to/value. Look back up to 5,000 blocks (~2.8 h); optional event-signature filter. Internal transactions are not included. Takes about 14 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

blocks.description: How many recent blocks to scan, 1-5000 (default 500; Base makes a block every 2 s)

topic0.description: Optional event signature hash (0x + 64 hex) to keep only that event, e.g. the Transfer topic

tools.name: crypto_arbitrum_l1_batches
tools.description: Arbitrum One rollup batch postings to Ethereum L1 and the L1 gas they incurred: the latest SequencerBatchDelivered events on the SequencerInbox with batch number, L1 block and time, data location (blob or calldata), poster, execution gas, blob gas, gas prices and fees in ETH, plus totals. Read from Ethereum mainnet via Etherscan API V2. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_optimism_recent_blocks
tools.description: OP Mainnet (Optimism) recent blocks from the public RPC: transactions per block, gas used per block, block time, and the transaction rate over the last N blocks (1 to 10). Sequencer revenue and Superchain-wide totals are not in this RPC and are not reported. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_kaspa_recent_blocks when you need the most recent Kaspa blocks: hash, block timestamp, blue. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

blocks.description: How many latest blocks to read, 2 to 10 (default 5)

tools.name: crypto_polygon_pos_checkpoints
tools.description: Polygon PoS checkpoints from the Heimdall API: the latest K checkpoints (1 to 10) with their Bor block range, timestamp and proposer, plus the average spacing in blocks and seconds. Checkpoints are the Ethereum-anchored root commitments. State-sync logs are not included. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_chainlink_price_feeds
tools.description: Chainlink on-chain price feed (ETH/USD or BTC/USD, Ethereum mainnet): latest round answer in USD, round id, and the start and update times with the age of the last update in seconds. Only the two feeds listed here are supported. Heartbeat and deviation thresholds are not reported. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_pyth_network_oracles
tools.description: Pyth Network oracle prices with confidence bands, read on-chain from Pyth's Solana push feeds: price, confidence interval (absolute and %), EMA price and EMA confidence, publish time and age in seconds, feed id and account, for up to 20 symbols (BTCUSD, ETHUSD, SOLUSD, gold XAUUSD, stablecoins, LST rates; ~65 feeds). Call with list=true for every available symbol. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

symbols.description: Comma-separated Pyth symbols, e.g. BTCUSD,ETHUSD (1 to 20)

list.description: true to list the available symbols instead

tools.name: crypto_uniswap_v3_ticks
tools.description: Uniswap V3 liquidity distribution for an Ethereum pool, read on-chain: tokens, fee tier, tick spacing, current tick and price (both directions, decimals applied), in-range liquidity, and every initialized tick within a window around the price with its price, liquidityNet and the active liquidity of the range above it — the shape of concentrated liquidity. Default pool: USDC/WETH 0.05%. Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

pool.description: Uniswap V3 pool address on Ethereum (default USDC/WETH 0.05%)

words.description: Tick-bitmap words to scan each side of the price, 1 to 5 (default 2; one word = 256 tick spacings)

tools.name: crypto_curve_gauge_weights
tools.description: Curve Finance gauges on one chain (default Ethereum): CRV emission APR range, CRV inflation rate per second and working supply per gauge, with the pool name and addresses. Sorted by CRV APR, top 1 to 50. Relative gauge weights and bribe yields are not in this source and are not reported. Small pools can show very high APR. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_curve_finance_pools when you need Curve Finance pools on Ethereum: pool name, total USD value. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: Curve blockchainId, e.g. ethereum, arbitrum (default ethereum)

tools.name: crypto_convex_vlcvx_voting
tools.description: Convex Finance (cvx.eth) governance on Snapshot: the newest proposals (1 to 20) with title, state, start and end time, number of votes and the top two choice scores. Votes are the Snapshot tallies. vlCVX lock balances and per-wallet voting power are not in this source and are not reported. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_balancer_v2_pools
tools.description: Balancer V2 pools by total liquidity (USD): pool name, type (weighted, stable, composable stable, and others), token symbols with weights where the pool has them, 24h volume and address. Top 1 to 20. Values are as the Balancer API reports them; some pools show implausible liquidity and are not corrected. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: crypto_sushiswap_route_quotes
tools.description: SushiSwap route quote for an exact-input swap on one EVM chain: amount out, swap price, price impact, gas spent and the tokens in the route. Quote only, no transaction data. The API needs a sender address; if none is given, a fixed placeholder address is sent and nothing is signed or executed. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

tokenIn.description: Token to sell, 0x address (use the wrapped token for native ETH)

amountIn.description: Amount to sell in the token's smallest unit (wei for 18 decimals)

sender.description: Optional sender address for the API (quote unaffected)

tools.name: crypto_1inch_pathfinder_quotes
tools.description: Best swap quote for a token pair on an EVM chain, compared across two public DEX aggregators (KyberSwap and Velora/ParaSwap): amount out, USD values, estimated gas in USD, price impact against the input's USD value and the pools/DEXes used, plus which aggregator gives more.
